# Privacy Policy

**Last updated:** May 17, 2026

The NanoDev Foundation ("we", "our", or "us") operates open-source Command Line Interfaces (CLIs) and Terminal User Interfaces (TUIs). We value your privacy and believe in absolute transparency regarding data collection.

## 1. Data Collection
Because our tools are open-source CLIs and TUIs running locally on your machine, **we do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data or usage analytics** to external servers by default. 

* **Local Configuration:** Any configuration files, keys, or data generated by our software remain strictly on your local environment.
* **Website Traffic:** If you browse our documentation website, standard, non-identifying server logs (such as IP address, browser type, and time of visit) may be automatically processed by our web hosting provider to ensure stability and security.

## 2. Third-Party Services
If our open-source tools integrate with third-party APIs (e.g., GitHub, package managers, or external developer tools) based on your user configurations, your interaction with those services is governed by their respective privacy policies. We encourage you to review them.

## 3. Data Security
Since your data lives on your own device, the security of that data depends on your local system's security configurations. We follow industry best practices in our open-source code to ensure our binaries and scripts do not introduce vulnerabilities.

## 4. Changes to This Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted directly on this page with an updated revision date.

## 5. Contact Us
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please open an issue on our official repository or contact us via our community channels.
